title: Restaurant - ASL Communication Demo
description: A server takes an order from a Deaf customer who responds in ASL, translated by SignBridge.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Welcome in! Can I get you something to drink?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.asl_sentence: A hot coffee and a cold beer.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Great choices. Are you ready to order food?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.asl_sentence: I'll order the fish, lobster, and bacon.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Excellent. Would you like anything on the side?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.asl_sentence: Bread, cheese, and carrots on the side.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Perfect. Can I get you any dessert?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.asl_sentence: Apple cherry pie, I'll enjoy that.
